title: Your radio's controls
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Each control on your radio fixes a problem. A weak FM station hidden? Open the squelch.
lines.label: open the squelch

lines.caption: A single sideband voice too high or too low? The RIT moves only your receive frequency.
lines.label: fix the pitch

lines.caption: Too much noise? Pick a filter as wide as the signal: 2400 hertz for single sideband voice.
lines.label: match the filter

lines.caption: Your own audio harsh? Turn down the microphone gain.
lines.label: less gain

lines.caption: Digital radios need settings first: a code plug for DMR, and your call sign for D-STAR.
lines.label: settings first
